metadata.description: Claude Code skills (ponytail, frontend-design, web-design-guidelines, security-audit, karpathy-guidelines, superpowers) and MCP servers (Context7, Playwright, GitHub, WhatsApp).

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode: the smallest change that fully solves the task.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Distinctive, intentional visual design for new or reshaped UI.

plugins.name: web-design-guidelines
plugins.description: Review UI code against Vercel's Web Interface Guidelines.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: Cloudflare's multi-phase security audit skill (cloudflare/security-audit-skill, MIT) for repos you own.

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Context7 MCP server (upstash/context7, MIT): up-to-date, version-specific library docs.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Playwright MCP server (microsoft/playwright-mcp, Apache-2.0): drive a real browser from Claude.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub MCP server (github/github-mcp-server, MIT): repos, issues, PRs and Actions. Needs GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.

plugins.name: whatsapp
plugins.description: WhatsApp MCP server (lharries/whatsapp-mcp, MIT). Needs a local clone with the Go bridge running and WHATSAPP_MCP_DIR set.

plugins.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
plugins.description: Karpathy-inspired coding guidelines (multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills, MIT): think first, keep it simple, make surgical changes.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Superpowers skills library (obra/superpowers, MIT): brainstorming, plans, TDD, systematic debugging, code review and subagent workflows.
